card.title: HENDERSON FIELD
card.text: Henderson Field is the air base the US is constructing on Guadalcanal.

value.value: Our best bet is to maintain our defensive position at Alligator Creek. Support it as best you can.

value.value: Our intelligence efforts are paying off, the enemy is stunned. Let’s maintain our strong forward position.

value.value: We are being reinforced to deal with the attacking force for good.

value.value: The enemy is recklessly charging our position, despite the heavy losses.

value.value: Still the enemy comes. We must keep our eye on the ball to finish them off.

value.value: Ichiki and his men are approaching our position at Alligator Creek. We have dealt with their scouts, so they don’t realize our strength.
